<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes>application/json</consumes><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>license_position</name><operation_script><![CDATA[/**
 * Scripted REST API «ITAM Demo» (API-ID itam_demo), Ressource GET /license_position
 *
 * Liefert die gespeicherte Lizenzposition einer Firma aus u_itam_license_position,
 * nur lesend (nur GET, das Skript schreibt nichts). Für Prüfskripte und den
 * KI-Assistenten, die die Tabelle selbst nicht lesen sollen.
 * Parameter: company (Standard «Muster AG»).
 */
(function process(/*RESTAPIRequest*/ request, /*RESTAPIResponse*/ response) {
    var param = request.queryParams.company;
    var companyName = param && param.length ? String(param[0]) : 'Muster AG';
    var positions = [];
    var calculatedAt = '';
    var pos = new GlideRecord('u_itam_license_position');
    pos.addQuery('u_company.name', companyName);
    pos.orderBy('u_difference');
    pos.query();
    while (pos.next()) {
        positions.push({
            product: pos.u_software_model.name.toString(),
            publisher: pos.getValue('u_publisher'),
            metric: pos.getValue('u_metric'),
            rights: parseInt(pos.getValue('u_rights'), 10),
            usage: parseInt(pos.getValue('u_usage'), 10),
            difference: parseInt(pos.getValue('u_difference'), 10),
            status: pos.getValue('u_status')
        });
        if (pos.getValue('sys_updated_on') > calculatedAt) calculatedAt = pos.getValue('sys_updated_on');
    }
    // JSON.stringify statt Rückgabe des Objekts: sonst kommen ganze Zahlen als 5.0 an
    response.setContentType('application/json');
    response.setStatus(200);
    response.getStreamWriter().writeString(JSON.stringify({
        result: {company: companyName, calculated_at: calculatedAt, positions: positions}
    }));
})(request, response);
]]></operation_script><operation_uri>/api/371499/itam_demo/license_position</operation_uri><produces>application/json</produces><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/license_position</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description>Lizenzposition einer Firma (nur lesend)</short_description><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 08:13:44</sys_created_on><sys_id>02f2f6a8c328171015b012d4e40131c5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>license_position</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_02f2f6a8c328171015b012d4e40131c5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 08:17:17</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition display_value="ITAM Demo">a5f276e8c328171015b012d4e401311b</web_service_definition><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>

 * beiden (eine Installation je Paket und Gerät, wiederholte Läufe erzeugen

 * eine Installation ohne Gerät oder ohne Software anzulegen.
 */
(function runTransformScript(source, map, log, target /*undefined onStart*/) {
    var sam = new MusterSamImport();
    var missing = [];
    if (!sam.softwarePackage(source.getValue('u_display_name'), source.getValue('u_version'))) {
        missing.push('Softwarepaket ' + source.getValue('u_display_name') + ' ' + source.getValue('u_version'));
    }
    if (!sam.device(source.getValue('u_installed_on'))) {
        missing.push('Gerät ' + source.getValue('u_installed_on'));
    }
    if (missing.length) {
        error = true;
        error_message = 'Nicht gefunden: ' + missing.join(', ');
    }
})(source, map, log, target);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_transform_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 08:07:11</sys_created_on><sys_id>ca7136e4c328171015b012d4e401311a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>onBefore</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_script_ca7136e4c328171015b012d4e401311a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 08:07:11</sys_updated_on><when>onBefore</when></sys_transform_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.MusterSamImport</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>ITAM Demo Meilenstein 3 (SAM)</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>MusterSamImport</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Script Include «MusterSamImport» (global, nur serverseitig)
 * Nachschlagefunktionen für die Transform Maps des SAM-Imports
 * (Software, Installationen, Lizenzen). Die Feldzuordnungen rufen nur diese
 * Funktionen auf, damit die Logik an einer Stelle steht.
 */
var MusterSamImport = Class.create();
MusterSamImport.COMPANY = 'Muster AG';
// Lizenzmetrik der Testdaten -> Lizenztyp der Plattform (cmdb_sw_license_calculation)
MusterSamImport.LICENSE_TYPES = {'Per User': 'Per named user', 'Per Device': 'Per workstation'};

MusterSamImport.prototype = {
    initialize: function () {},

    /** Hersteller per Name; fehlt er, wird er als Hersteller angelegt. */
    manufacturer: function (name) {
        if (!name) return '';
        var company = new GlideRecord('core_company');
        if (company.get('name', name)) return company.getUniqueValue();
        company.initialize();
        company.setValue('name', name);
        company.setValue('manufacturer', true);
        return company.insert();
    },

    /** Lizenztyp der Plattform zur Metrik; «Free» und Unbekanntes bleiben leer. */
    licenseType: function (metric) {
        var name = MusterSamImport.LICENSE_TYPES[metric];
        if (!name) return '';
        var type = new GlideRecord('cmdb_sw_license_calculation');
        return type.get('name', name) ? type.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    /** Normalisiertes Softwaremodell, auf das sich Lizenzen beziehen. */
    softwareModel: function (product, publisher) {
        var model = new GlideRecord('cmdb_software_product_model');
        model.addQuery('name', product);
        model.addQuery('manufacturer.name', publisher);
        model.query();
        return model.next() ? model.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    /** Softwarepaket, wie ein Inventar-Tool es meldet: Rohname und Version. */
    softwarePackage: function (displayName, version) {
        var pkg = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_spkg');
        pkg.addQuery('name', displayName);
        pkg.addQuery('version', version);
        pkg.query();
        return pkg.next() ? pkg.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    /** Gerät der Muster AG per Name (Inventarname; die IRE hat Scan-Dubletten zusammengeführt). */
    device: function (name) {
        var ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_hardware');
        ci.addQuery('name', name);
        ci.addQuery('company.name', MusterSamImport.COMPANY);
        ci.orderBy('sys_created_on');
        ci.query();
        return ci.next() ? ci.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    company: function () {
        var company = new GlideRecord('core_company');
        return company.get('name', MusterSamImport.COMPANY) ? company.getUniqueValue() : '';
    },

    /** Je Version ein Softwarepaket anlegen bzw. aktualisieren und mit dem Modell verknüpfen. */
    upsertPackages: function (modelId, manufacturerId, displayName, versions) {
        var count = 0;
        var list = (versions || '').split('|');
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            var version = list[i].trim();
            if (!version) continue;
            var pkg = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_spkg');
            pkg.addQuery('name', displayName);
            pkg.addQuery('version', version);
            pkg.query();
            if (!pkg.next()) {
                pkg.initialize();
                pkg.setValue('name', displayName);
                pkg.setValue('version', version);
            }
            pkg.setValue('manufacturer', manufacturerId);
            pkg.setValue('model_id', modelId);
            if (pkg.isNewRecord()) pkg.insert(); else pkg.update();
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    },

    type: 'MusterSamImport'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 08:06:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>4241fa24c328171015b012d4e40131c1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>MusterSamImport</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_4241fa24c328171015b012d4e40131c1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 08:06:21</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.ItamLicensePosition</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>ITAM Demo Meilenstein 3 (SAM)</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>ItamLicensePosition</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[/**
 * Script Include «ItamLicensePosition» (global, nur serverseitig)
 *
 * Lizenzposition je Softwaremodell einer Firma: gekaufte Rechte (alm_license)
 * gegen Nutzung (cmdb_software_instance auf Geräten der Firma). Ersetzt die
 * Compliance-Berechnung von SAM Pro, das auf der Entwicklerinstanz nicht aktiv
 * ist. Zählweise bewusst einfach und gleich wie im Testdaten-Generator:
 * - «Per workstation»: Geräte mit mindestens einer Installation des Produkts
 * - «Per named user»: verschiedene Benutzer dieser Geräte; Geräte ohne
 *   Benutzer zählen je einmal (sonst fiele ungenutzte Hardware durch)
 * Produkte ohne Lizenztyp (Freeware) zählen nur, wenn eine Lizenz existiert.
 *
 * Ergebnis in u_itam_license_position, eine Zeile je Produkt. Aufruf:
 *   new ItamLicensePosition('Muster AG').store()
 * (onComplete der Transform Map «Muster AG Lizenzen» und täglicher Scheduled Job).
 */
var ItamLicensePosition = Class.create();
ItamLicensePosition.TABLE = 'u_itam_license_position';
ItamLicensePosition.PER_USER = 'Per named user';
ItamLicensePosition.PER_DEVICE = 'Per workstation';

/** Gleiche Reihenfolge wie sam_expectation im Generator. */
ItamLicensePosition.status = function (licensed, rights, usage) {
    if (!licensed) return 'ohne Lizenz';
    if (usage == 0) return 'ungenutzt';
    if (rights < usage) return 'unterlizenziert';
    if (rights > usage) return 'überlizenziert';
    return 'ausgeglichen';
};

ItamLicensePosition.prototype = {
    initialize: function (companyName) {
        this.companyName = companyName || 'Muster AG';
    },

    /** Berechnet die Position; gibt eine Liste von Objekten zurück (schreibt nichts). */
    calculate: function () {
        var usage = {};   // Modell -> {Gerät: Benutzer}
        var rights = {};  // Modell -> Summe der Rechte

        var inst = new GlideRecord('cmdb_software_instance');
        inst.addQuery('installed_on.company.name', this.companyName);
        inst.addNotNullQuery('software.model_id');
        inst.query();
        while (inst.next()) {
            var modelId = inst.software.model_id.toString();
            usage[modelId] = usage[modelId] || {};
            usage[modelId][inst.getValue('installed_on')] = inst.installed_on.assigned_to.toString();
        }

        var lic = new GlideRecord('alm_license');
        lic.addQuery('company.name', this.companyName);
        lic.addQuery('install_status', '!=', '7');  // ausgemusterte Lizenzen zählen nicht
        lic.addNotNullQuery('model');
        lic.query();
        while (lic.next()) {
            var licModel = lic.getValue('model');
            rights[licModel] = (rights[licModel] || 0) + parseInt(lic.getValue('rights') || '0', 10);
        }

        var ids = {};
        var id;
        for (id in usage) ids[id] = true;
        for (id in rights) ids[id] = true;

        var rows = [];
        for (id in ids) {
            var model = new GlideRecord('cmdb_software_product_model');
            if (!model.get(id)) continue;
            var metric = model.license_type.getDisplayValue();
            var licensed = rights.hasOwnProperty(id);
            if (!licensed && metric != ItamLicensePosition.PER_USER && metric != ItamLicensePosition.PER_DEVICE) {
                continue;  // Freeware ohne Lizenz
            }
            var used = this._usage(usage[id] || {}, metric);
            var owned = rights[id] || 0;
            rows.push({
                model: id,
                product: model.getValue('name'),
                publisher: model.manufacturer.getDisplayValue(),
                metric: metric,
                rights: owned,
                usage: used,
                difference: owned - used,
                status: ItamLicensePosition.status(licensed, owned, used)
            });
        }
        rows.sort(function (a, b) { return a.difference - b.difference || (a.product < b.product ? -1 : 1); });
        return rows;
    },

    /** Berechnet und ersetzt die Zeilen der Firma in u_itam_license_position. */
    store: function () {
        var company = new GlideRecord('core_company');
        if (!company.get('name', this.companyName)) return 0;
        var rows = this.calculate();

        var old = new GlideRecord(ItamLicensePosition.TABLE);
        old.addQuery('u_company', company.getUniqueValue());
        old.deleteMultiple();

        for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
            var r = rows[i];
            var pos = new GlideRecord(ItamLicensePosition.TABLE);
            pos.initialize();
            pos.setValue('u_company', company.getUniqueValue());
            pos.setValue('u_software_model', r.model);
            pos.setValue('u_publisher', r.publisher);
            pos.setValue('u_metric', r.metric);
            // String(): sonst speichert Rhino Zahlen als «20.0»
            pos.setValue('u_rights', String(r.rights));
            pos.setValue('u_usage', String(r.usage));
            pos.setValue('u_difference', String(r.difference));
            pos.setValue('u_status', r.status);
            pos.insert();
        }
        return rows.length;
    },

    _usage: function (devices, metric) {
        var count = 0;
        var users = {};
        for (var device in devices) {
            var user = devices[device];
            if (metric == ItamLicensePosition.PER_USER && user) {
                users[user] = true;
            } else {
                count++;  // pro Gerät, oder Gerät ohne Benutzer
            }
        }
        for (var u in users) count++;
        return count;
    },

    type: 'ItamLicensePosition'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-11 08:06:23</sys_created_on><sys_id>d241faa4c328171015b012d4e401316b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ItamLicensePosition</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_d241faa4c328171015b012d4e401316b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-11 08:13:37</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
